<\STATESEP>theory None_Top_Bot
  imports Monads.Fun_Pred_Syntax
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition none_top :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> 'a option \<Rightarrow> 'b::top" where
  "none_top \<equiv> case_option top"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition none_bot :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> 'a option \<Rightarrow> 'b::bot" where
  "none_bot \<equiv> case_option bot"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>section \<open>General lattice properties for @{const none_top}\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_simps[simp]:
  "none_top f None = top"
  "none_top f (Some x) = f x"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. none_top f None = top &&& none_top f (Some x) = f x<\STATESEP>by (auto simp: none_top_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_split:
  "P (none_top f opt) = ((opt = None \<longrightarrow> P top) \<and> (\<forall>x. opt = Some x \<longrightarrow> P (f x)))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. P (none_top f opt) = ((opt = None \<longrightarrow> P top) \<and> (\<forall>x. opt = Some x \<longrightarrow> P (f x)))<\STATESEP>by (cases opt) auto<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_split_asm:
  "P (none_top f opt) = (\<not> (opt = None \<and> \<not> P top \<or> (\<exists>x. opt = Some x \<and> \<not> P (f x))))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. P (none_top f opt) = (\<not> (opt = None \<and> \<not> P top \<or> (\<exists>x. opt = Some x \<and> \<not> P (f x))))<\STATESEP>by (cases opt) auto<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas none_top_splits = none_top_split none_top_split_asm<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_if:
  "none_top f opt = (if opt = None then top else f (the opt))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. none_top f opt = (if opt = None then top else f (the opt))<\STATESEP>by (cases opt) auto<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_Inf:
  "none_top f opt = (Inf {f x |x. opt = Some x} :: 'a :: complete_lattice)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. none_top f opt = Inf {f x |x. opt = Some x}<\STATESEP>by (cases opt) auto<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_top[simp]:
  "none_top top = top"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. none_top top = top<\STATESEP>by (rule ext) (simp split: none_top_splits)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>section \<open>Bool/fun lemmas for @{const none_top}\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_bool_all:
  "none_top f opt = (\<forall>x. opt = Some x \<longrightarrow> f x)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. none_top f opt = (\<forall>x. opt = Some x \<longrightarrow> f x)<\STATESEP>by (auto simp: none_top_Inf)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_bool_cases:
  "none_top f opt = (opt = None \<or> (\<exists>x. opt = Some x \<and> f x))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. none_top f opt = (opt = None \<or> (\<exists>x. opt = Some x \<and> f x))<\STATESEP>by (cases opt) auto<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_boolI:
  "(\<And>x. opt = Some x \<Longrightarrow> f x) \<Longrightarrow> none_top f opt"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. (\<And>x. opt = Some x \<Longrightarrow> f x) \<Longrightarrow> none_top f opt<\STATESEP>by (simp add: none_top_bool_all)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_boolD:
  "none_top f opt \<Longrightarrow> opt = None \<or> (\<exists>x. opt = Some x \<and> f x)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)

 1. none_top f opt \<Longrightarrow> opt = None \<or> (\<exists>x. opt = Some x \<and> f x)<\STATESEP>by (cases opt) auto<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_boolE:

  "none_top \<bottom> opt = (opt = None)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)

  "none_top bot opt = (opt = None)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)

 1. none_top bot opt = (opt = None)<\STATESEP>by (cases opt) auto<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_True[simp]:
  "none_top \<top> = \<top>"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)

  "none_top \<top> opt"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)

 1. none_top (\<lambda>_. True) opt<\STATESEP>by simp<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma none_top_fun_all:
